- Never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/pull/push or any mutating jj command in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin; read-only git is fine. Never run jj at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin. If you need a clone: `git clone -q /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r41w2/<YourName>/clone` after unsetting GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE.
